summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host identifiers on install
details: Package com.db.dbk.ui-forms@99.0.0 runs a preinstall hook that collects the installer's hostname, OS username, install directory, timestamp, and package name and transmits them to the hardcoded external domain dcf.rootxravi.com via HTTPS POST to /dcf/<pkg>, with an out-of-band DNS channel that encodes host/user identifiers into a subdomain lookup (<id>.dcf.rootxravi.com). The package name mimics an internal namespace (com.db.dbk.*) and the version is set to 99.0.0 to outrank a private-registry package of the same name, matching the canonical dependency-confusion attack shape. A self-described 'research/proof of concept' framing does not change the executed behavior: any build system that resolves this name from the public registry leaks internal build-host metadata to a non-first-party endpoint on npm install.
